definitions.explanation: Natural gas supplied through underground pipelines to homes and businesses in urban areas, used for cooking, heating, and hot water.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{都市|とし}ガスだ。
examples.english: This apartment building uses city gas.

examples.japanese: {都市|とし}ガス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧プロパンガス⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: City gas is cheaper than propane gas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}→引っ越し先：21647_hikkoshisaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{都市|とし}ガス⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧プロパンガス⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: You should check whether your new place uses city gas or propane gas.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧ (city) + ⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧ (gas). In Japan, there are two main types of household gas: {都市|とし}ガス (city gas, piped) and プロパンガス (propane gas, delivered in tanks). City gas is generally cheaper and more common in urban areas, while propane is used in rural areas without gas pipeline infrastructure. This distinction is important when renting apartments in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都市|とし}ガス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧: property with city gas
- {都市|とし}ガス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: city gas charges
- {都市|とし}ガス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧: to switch to city gas

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プロパンガス: propane gas — delivered in tanks, more expensive but available in areas without gas pipelines
- LP⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧: LP gas — another name for propane gas
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}ガス→天然ガス：19038_tennengasu⟧: natural gas — the raw material; {都市|とし}ガス is the delivered product
